hero.title: Engineered for Substance, Not Software Bloat
hero.subtitle: VibePress Studio was created to build software tools that respect system resources and user privacy. We specialize in two primary domains: modular, high-performance WordPress infrastructure and offline-first, native desktop operating systems.

vision.headline: Engineered for Substance, Not Software Bloat
vision.narrative: VibePress Studio was created to build software tools that respect system resources and user privacy. We specialize in two primary domains: modular, high-performance WordPress infrastructure and offline-first, native desktop operating systems.
vision.philosophy: We avoid bloated architectures, unnecessary database tables, and unneeded cloud dependencies. Whether operating on an enterprise WordPress site or a local desktop workstation, our tools deliver deterministic, rock-solid performance.

pillars.title: Modular, Standards-Based WordPress Code
pillars.desc: Engineered strictly according to WordPress Core Coding Standards, PSR-4 class auto-loading, and PSR-12 conventions.

pillars.title: Modern Desktop Architecture
pillars.desc: Leveraging Rust and Tauri v2 to deliver native binaries that run with fractional memory usage compared to Electron applications.

pillars.title: Local-First Data Sovereignty
pillars.desc: User data belongs to the user; our desktop software runs fully isolated on local ACID-compliant SQLite databases.

pillars.title: Multi-Channel Distribution
pillars.desc: We deliver our software through WordPress.org, Freemius, and AppSumo to provide accessible, flexible licensing for creators and businesses.
